paper_metadata.title: A Study of the High-Temperature Strength of Titanium Alloys Using Nanoindentation and Micro-cantilever Bending Tests

evidence.quote: The Ti-6Al-4V alloy, which is one of the most common titanium alloys, has also been applied to fan and cooler parts of compressors.
Near a-Ti alloys, such as Ti-6242S (Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Zr-2Mo-0.1Si) and IMI-834 (Ti-5.8Al-4Sn-3.5Zr-0.5Mo-0.7Nb-0.35Si), have been developed to improve heat resistance based on Ti-6Al-4V.
